Service Name
ComM_Nm_UpdateEIRA
Syntax

const uint8* PncBitVectorPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x6c
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
PncBitVectorPtr
Pointer to the PNC bit vector which contain the current
aggregated internal and external PNC requests (EIRA)
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Function to indicate the current aggregated external / internal PNC request called by Nm.
Available via
ComM_Nm.h
⌋(SRS_ModeMgm_09248, SRS_ModeMgm_09250)
caption: 8.4.1.9 ComM_Nm_UpdateEIRA

targets.why: Specifies ComM handling of ComM_Nm_UpdateEIRA call.
Nm calls ComM_Nm_UpdateEIRA upon EIRA changes.
